notes:
Account summary: Auric Lattice Research — boutique institutional research provider building a unified knowledge portal (sell-side style research, transcripts, analyst notes, and filings). Primary focus: accurate retrieval for analyst workflows and downstream reranker to improve precision for traders.

Scale & performance requirements:
- Target index size: 120M-200M vectors (mix of 1kB and 5kB doc chunks).
- QPS: steady 3-5 qps for analysts, bursts to 15-25 qps during market events.
- Latency target (end-to-end embeddings + retrieval + learned rerank): p95 < 250ms at steady load, p95 < 450ms under burst.
- Cost sensitivity: aiming for total cost per query (embedding + vector lookup + rerank) ~ <$0.03; willing to trade some cost for guaranteed latency.

Model & infra preferences:
- Prefer dedicated GPU capacity for consistent latency and KV cache guarantees.
- Embeddings preference: multi-vector ensemble (financial-tuned embedder + general embedder) — open to Redwood recommended models; want performance profiles.
- Reranker: learned reranker (BERT/longformer variant) applied on top-K to reduce hallucination; want Redwood to host reranker or provide clear orchestration.
- Vector store: evaluating Redwood's routing vs. in-house vector DB; prefer single-pane observability.

Security / compliance / data residency:
- Must support VPC/private deployment for EU customer data (subset of corpus), KMS integration (customer-managed keys), audit logging for access to sensitive transcripts.
- ISO27001 and SOC2 evidence required; legal asked for retention and deletion flows.

POC ask & metrics:
- 2-week POC on Dedicated capacity ingesting 5M documents (synthetic + redacted production) to validate throughput and rerank accuracy.
- Deliverables: ingestion guide, p95 latency reports, cost-per-query estimate, KMS integration test.
- Success criteria: p95 < 250ms for steady 5 qps; reranker improves top-3 precision by >=12% vs lexical baseline; documented KMS key rotation + audit log proof-of-concept.

Sales notes (shorthand):
- "If we can't keep p95 under 250ms it's a no-go" — VP Eng (quote on 2026-01-11).
- Legal: need explicit EU residency SLA and subprocessor list.
- Infra: wants kernel choices / quantization guidance for cost. Asked about Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching.

Open action items:
- Send SOW + two capacity options (steady vs burst) by 2026-02-12.
- Prep security pack: SOC2, ISO certs, KMS integration diagram.
- Schedule 60-min infra deep-dive w/ platform eng (target week of 2026-02-15).

Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), call transcripts (fireflies ids), legal thread (gmail).
